name: ari-gala-dress
description: a young woman with a white chin-length bob with soft side-swept bangs whose tips fade to aqua, pale skin, large light blue eyes with long lashes, FULL SOFT LIPS, an hourglass figure with a full bust, a narrow waist, wide hips, thick thighs and a large round buttocks. NO headband with this outfit. Large thin GOLD HOOP earrings. A short gold chain necklace with one round blue gem pendant in a gold setting that sits at the base of her throat on the front of the dress's collar. She wears a floor-length evening gown of glossy IRIDESCENT pearl-white satin that shimmers lavender, pink and pale aqua, with thin pale-gold seam lines running down the bodice and skirt: a high HALTER neck - a narrow band collar around the neck, no sleeves, bare shoulders and arms - a KEYHOLE cut-out below the collar opening onto a deep cleavage, a fitted bodice and waist, and a long column skirt that hugs the hips and falls to the floor in a slightly pooling hem. ONE high SLIT runs up the front of the skirt over HER RIGHT LEG (the viewer's left when she faces the camera) almost to the hip, so her right leg shows bare to the upper thigh; her left leg stays covered. The back is OPEN: bare from the nape down to the small of the back, where the skirt begins in a V just above the buttocks, and two thin gold chains run from the back of the collar down across the bare back in an X to the edges of the V. The skirt covers the buttocks fully and hugs them tightly. The gown is ALWAYS floor-length in every view: when the frame ends above the knees (cowboy shots, upper-body views), the skirt simply continues out of the bottom of the frame - never shorten it into a mini dress or a hem above the knee to fit the frame. Gold strappy stiletto sandals with a thin ankle strap and crossing straps over the foot; bare toes. She does NOT hold anything: no glass, no clutch, no bag, no bracelet, no bangle, no watch, no gloves, no headband, no tattoos. Views with her back toward the camera never show the pendant (it sits on the front of the collar) - only the collar band and the gold chains across the bare back. Profile views: a view from her LEFT side shows her body facing the viewer's LEFT; a view from her RIGHT side shows her body facing the viewer's RIGHT; the slit is on HER RIGHT leg in every view, so it is on the near leg in a right-side profile. In any view from her LEFT side - left profile, left three-quarter, looking back over the left shoulder - the skirt is CLOSED: one smooth unbroken column of iridescent fabric from the hip to the floor, NO slit, NO opening and NO bare leg or thigh visible at all; the slit and the right leg are on the far side, hidden by the skirt. The reference sheet's only profile is her RIGHT side, where the slit is - do NOT copy that open slit into any view from her left side; from the left the dress looks like a closed evening gown with the left leg fully covered to the floor.
audit: dress: floor-length glossy iridescent pearl-white satin (lavender / pink / aqua sheen), thin pale-gold seam lines; never matte, never a solid colour, never short; ALWAYS floor-length - in cowboy/upper frames the skirt runs out of the frame, never a mini
neck: high halter band collar, bare shoulders and arms, KEYHOLE cut-out over the cleavage below the collar; no sleeves, no straps on the shoulders

slit: ONE high slit on HER RIGHT leg (viewer's left from the front) to the upper thigh; left leg covered; never two slits, never on the left leg; from her LEFT side the skirt is closed and no leg shows
back: open from the nape to the small of the back, skirt starting in a V just above the buttocks, two thin gold chains crossing in an X over the bare back; buttocks covered
jewellery: large thin gold hoop earrings (never teardrops); gold chain with a round blue gem pendant at the front of the collar, never visible from behind
hair: white chin-length bob, aqua tips, side-swept bangs, NO headband
shoes: gold strappy stiletto sandals with ankle straps, bare toes, both feet in frame on body views
hands: empty - no glass, no clutch, no bracelet or bangle
figure: hourglass, full bust, narrow waist, wide hips, thick thighs, round buttocks; anatomy correct - no twisted or mismatched legs
frame: body views head to soles with margin; face views head and shoulders WITH the collar and keyhole in frame; no text, no sheet panels
background: a plain, even, pale icy-blue background with no scenery or shadows
